couplets.en: This time, the two of us.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhre to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milen
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps someday we will meet in dreams.

lines: Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milen
couplets.en: As dried flowers turn up between the pages of books.

Look among those whose lives have fallen apart.

lines: Dhoond ujre hue logon mein wafa ke moti
couplets.en: Look for pearls of fidelity among those whose lives have fallen apart.

lines: Ye khazane tujhe mumkin hai kharabon mein milen
couplets.en: You may find these treasures amid the ruins.

lines: Tu khuda hai na mera ishq farishton jaisa
couplets.en: You are no god, and my love is no angel's.

lines: Donon insaan hain to kyun itne hijabon mein milen
couplets.en: We are both human, so why meet behind so many veils?

lines: Gham-e-duniya bhi gham-e-yaar mein shamil kar lo
couplets.en: Let the sorrow of the world mingle with the sorrow of love.

lines: Nasha barhta hai sharaben jo sharabon mein milen
couplets.en: The wine goes to the head when wines are mingled.
